description.en: Fossil specimen morphology only, not a whole living alga. Herak1965 D. annulata sensu stricto PlateVI2–4 and description support cylindrical annulated thallus, central lumen and lateral canals. Do not use PlateVI1 old D.dolomitica/Kantia morphology. Hand-scale0.10m display is intentionally enlarged from millimetric fossils, not a fossil measurement. Three segments and96 channels are schematic counts; pore layout and size enhance readability and do not reproduce taxonomic microstructure or claim all lateral tuft branches are individually resolved.

scientific_scope.en: Fossil specimen morphology only, not a whole living alga. Herak1965 D. annulata sensu stricto PlateVI2–4 and description support cylindrical annulated thallus, central lumen and lateral canals. Do not use PlateVI1 old D.dolomitica/Kantia morphology. Hand-scale0.10m display is intentionally enlarged from millimetric fossils, not a fossil measurement. Three segments and96 channels are schematic counts; pore layout and size enhance readability and do not reproduce taxonomic microstructure or claim all lateral tuft branches are individually resolved. File-space dimensions are exported geometry bounds, not real-world specimen/locality measurements. Catalogue category is navigation only, not a claim of settled biological affinity.
